notes: Single panel. Streets: Depot along the left edge (east face x~316-322, west face off the paper, 60 ft), the C.H.&D. railroad yard and Gest St. Repair Shops (name of the railroad shops, not a street), Summer (50 ft) from Gest north to a closed end at y~1677, Berlin (50 ft) from Gest north across Hopkins to a closed end at y~1357, Evans (52 ft, 50 ft north of Hopkins) along the right side to the top edge, Hopkins (60 ft) from Summer east across Berlin and Evans, and Gest along the bottom edge. Gest is only partly on the paper: its north face is drawn at y~7597-7648 but the paper ends at y~7700-7740, so every Gest crossing centre is below the paper edge. The three Gest picks (Summer, Berlin, Evans) are EXTRAPOLATED 183 px (30 ft of the printed 60 ft) south of the north face and marked as such in their notes; they are this sheet's only ties to sheets 467, 468 and 495, and the three Hopkins picks are collinear, so drop them only if you have another tie. Depot/Gest is NOT picked: its centre (x~142, y~7830) is beyond the scan itself and Depot's west face is off the paper too. The thin vertical line marked S in Evans north of Hopkins (x~6180) and the compass rose in Evans are not streets. Circled figures are grade elevations.
